family: R3-B4 breakthrough: calibration-mapping ensemble vote on frozen v30 outputs
hypothesis: Agreement across calibration mappings (isotonic_2/4/all) is a stronger confidence signal than any single map: ensemble vote as filter. Untried per ledger round3 B4.
method: Per decision row (same-row only, frozen mappings, never refit): compute choose() per map with the identical dataset policy config. Direction per map: LONG=+1, SHORT=-1, WAIT=0. Vote filters below gate rows BEFORE the frequency loop. Each branch then runs the IDENTICAL frequency loop (monthly cap 4 + 5-day cooldown, time order, causal past-only) over its passing rows; emitted geometry/scores are ALWAYS the iso4 choose() output on that row. No cross-row or future information; no threshold tuning.

votes.iso4_only: control: iso4 direction != WAIT (d4 != 0). Geometry = iso4 choose output.
votes.majority: 2-of-3 agree on direction: exists d in {+1,-1} with count({d2,d4,dAll} == d) >= 2 AND d4 == d (iso4 participates in the majority; take iso4 geometry on agreement rows). WAIT rows excluded.
votes.unanimous: 3-of-3 agree: d2 == d4 == dAll != 0. Geometry = iso4 choose output.
votes.confirmed: iso4-confirmed-by-isoall: d4 != 0 AND dAll == d4 (both non-WAIT same direction; iso2 ignored). Geometry = iso4 choose output.

control: iso4_only_1x must match published isotonic_4 exposure1.0 normal (+122.80% total_return 1.2279837998661565, -20.09% max_drawdown -0.20086073993367803, 65 trades) or STOP
dd_guard_reference: YOUR control-branch (iso4_only_1x) sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after), past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed level; each branch applies the guard state at its OWN signal times. Same formula as scripts/opencode_r1a_holding_probe.py.
